patterns.note: Large, highly rounded-corner cards are used consistently for product offers and pricing tiers, often arranged in flexible grids that adapt to content density.
A warm, inviting palette centers on a light peach/orange as a primary background for content sections, contrasted with a brighter, saturated orange for calls to action and key accents.

A playful, script-like display font is used for the brand logo and select large headings, providing a friendly, approachable tone that contrasts with the clean, modern sans-serif used for body text and most other headings.
The primary navigation transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background color, while the logo and text scale down proportionally, maintaining legibility.
Informational sections, such as FAQs and advice blocks, are presented within large, rounded-corner containers with a consistent light orange background, visually grouping related content.

technique_notes: Implement a header that is initially transparent and full-height, then uses CSS transitions to smoothly reduce its height, apply a solid background color, and scale down its internal logo and navigation text when the user scrolls past a certain threshold.

Utilize a grid system to display product offers and pricing plans within distinct, large cards featuring deeply rounded corners, subtle drop shadows, and a consistent internal layout for icons, titles, and value propositions.

Combine a custom, script-style font for the brand identity and emotional headlines with a highly readable sans-serif for all other textual content, ensuring a clear hierarchy and distinct brand voice.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are generally bold and range from large (~3x body) to medium (~1.5x body), with body text being legible and well-spaced; the display font for the logo is quite large in the hero.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently used across cards, buttons, input fields, and section containers, giving a soft, friendly feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections have generous vertical padding, and content within cards and lists is well-spaced.

standout: The playful, hand-drawn illustration style, particularly the product pass lanyards in the hero, combined with the warm, inviting color palette and soft rounded corners, creates a distinctive friendly and approachable brand identity for a product that is essentially a collection of software deals.
